app.name: SUtech Transportation
app.description: Book your seat, pay, track your bus and follow every trip at SUTech.

preview.dashboardBody: Placeholder numbers to check spacing and layout at every screen size.

gallery.title: Component gallery
gallery.description: Every base component in both languages and both themes. Use these, never one-off styles.
gallery.colorsNote: Tokens from the design system. Coral is for accents only; red is for errors and SOS only.
gallery.typeSample: The bus left Abbas El Akkad stop 4 minutes ago.

forms.studentIdHint: 9 digits, as on your university card
forms.phoneError: Enter an 11-digit number that starts with 01.

forms.agreeHint: You can read them in Settings.
forms.notifyParentHint: When you board, arrive and leave the bus.

status.infoBody: You'll get a notification the moment it opens.
status.dangerBody: The reference number is already used. Upload the right receipt.

lists.announcementTitle: Booking for spring term is open

tables.emptyBody: Add the first line to start taking bookings.

overlays.dialogBody: Your new stop applies from tomorrow's trip.
overlays.confirmBody: Your seat goes to the next student on the waiting list. This can't be undone.
overlays.toastErrorBody: Check your connection and try again.

states.emptyBody: When the bus is near or a request is answered, you'll see it here.

api.body: Calls GET /api/v1/health through the same client the real server will use. In mock mode it is answered in the browser; the response is still checked against its schema.

login.brandLead: One account for students, parents, drivers and every university office.
login.featureTracking: Follow your bus live on the map
login.featureCard: Your digital bus pass, always with you
login.featureSafety: Safer trips, with SOS and attendance
login.identifierLead: Enter your ID and we'll text a one-time code to your registered phone. No password needed.
login.identifierLabel: University ID, staff ID or phone
login.identifierHint: Students: your 9-digit university ID. Parents: the phone number registered with the university.
login.identifierRequired: Enter your ID or phone number.
login.identifierTooShort: This looks too short. Check it and try again.
login.codeLead: Hi {name}. We sent a {length}-digit code to <phone>{destination}</phone>.
login.codeExpired: This code has expired. Ask for a new one.
login.resent: A new code is on its way.
login.help: Can't sign in? Contact the Transportation office.

notices.expired: Your session ended. Sign in again to continue.
notices.signedOut: You've signed out. See you soon.

errors.unknownIdentifier: We couldn't find this ID. Check it, or contact the Transportation office.
errors.accountDisabled: This account is disabled. Contact the Transportation office.
errors.invalidOtp: Wrong code. {count, plural, =1 {1 attempt left.} other {# attempts left.}}
errors.otpExpired: This code has expired. Ask for a new one.
errors.otpLocked: Too many wrong codes. For your safety, try again in 15 minutes.
errors.otpRateLimited: Please wait a minute before asking for another code.
errors.network: No connection. Check your internet and try again.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Try again in a moment.

session.homeLead: You're signed in. Your pages arrive in the next phases.
session.comingBody: This is your home. The rest of your menu fills in phase by phase; every page you see is only one your role may open.

home.lead: Your university bus, in one place.

subscription.title: My subscription
subscription.noneBody: Pick a line and a stop, then pay within 24 hours to keep your seat.
subscription.reservedBody: Pay {amount} and upload the receipt before the hold ends, or the seat goes to someone else.
subscription.reviewBody: Finance is checking it. Your seat stays held meanwhile, and we'll tell you once it's approved.
subscription.expiredBody: The seat was released because no receipt arrived in time. You can book again.
subscription.cancelledBody: You can book another line or stop.

steps.title: How to subscribe
steps.pay: Pay at the bank, or by Visa in room A045
steps.upload: Upload the receipt and wait for approval

trip.title: Next trip
trip.approaching: On the way to your stop, about {time}
trip.passed_stop: Picked up, heading to campus, about {time}
trip.mapLater: The live map comes with bus tracking.

lines.lead: Every line costs {price} a term. Buses reach campus between {from} and {to}.
lines.searchPlaceholder: Area or line number, e.g. Nasr City or 12
lines.noResultsBody: Try another area name or line number.
lines.seatsLeft: {count, plural, one {# seat left} other {# seats left}}
lines.alreadyBooked: You already have a booking on {line}.
lines.estimateNote: Seat counts are estimates until the bus company confirms each bus.

line.stopsLead: Pick the stop where you'll get on.
line.stopsLeadReadOnly: In the order the bus passes them.
line.noLocation: Map pins come once the Transportation office sends the stop locations.
line.notFoundBody: This line doesn't exist or was removed.

booking.title: Book a seat
booking.chooseStop: Choose your stop from the list.
booking.hold: We hold the seat for 24 hours while you pay.
booking.fullBody: No seats left this term. Choose another line, or ask the Transportation office (room A039).
booking.alreadyBody: One subscription per term. To change it, cancel your unpaid booking first.

confirm.title: Book a seat on {line}?
confirm.body: Stop: {stop}, pickup {time}. Price: {price}. You'll have 24 hours to pay and upload the receipt.

line.bookedBody: Pay within 24 hours to keep it.

errors.SEAT_UNAVAILABLE: Someone just took the last seat. Pick another line.
errors.ALREADY_SUBSCRIBED: You already have a booking this term.
errors.STOP_NOT_ON_LINE: That stop isn't on this line any more. Reload and choose again.
errors.LINE_NOT_FOUND: This line was removed. Choose another one.
errors.network: No connection. Your seat wasn't booked; try again.
errors.generic: We couldn't book the seat. Try again.

booking.cancelBody: Your seat on {line} will be released, and you can book another line or stop.
booking.cancelError: We couldn't cancel the booking. Try again.

payment.lead: Pay the term fee to activate your subscription.
payment.noBookingBody: Choose a line and a stop, then come back here to pay.
payment.expiredBody: No receipt arrived in time, so the seat was released. Book again to pay.
payment.reviewBody: Finance is checking it. Your seat stays held until they decide.
payment.rejectedBody: {reason} Your seat is held again for 24 hours: upload a correct receipt.
payment.onlyTheseMethods: Only these two ways are accepted. There is no Fawry or InstaPay.

bank.title: Bank deposit or transfer
bank.lead: Deposit at any National Bank of Egypt branch, or transfer to this account. A direct deposit is best: transfers can take days to show.

office.title: Visa card at the university
office.body: Pay by card at the Accounting office, room {room}. {hours}.
office.after: Finance records the payment, and your subscription activates once it's confirmed. Then pass by the Transportation office, room {room}, if they ask you to confirm your details.

receipt.title: Upload the receipt
receipt.lead: The receipt must clearly show the student's name, the amount, your university ID, the account holder's name, the line and the stop.
receipt.referenceHint: The operation or slip number printed on the receipt.
receipt.payerHint: Often a parent's name, as it appears on the receipt.
receipt.fileHint: JPG, PNG or PDF, up to {size}.
receipt.amountTooLow: The amount must be at least {amount}.
receipt.dateInFuture: The date can't be in the future.
receipt.fileType: Only JPG, PNG or PDF files.
receipt.sentBody: Finance will review it. Your seat stays held meanwhile.

errors.HOLD_EXPIRED: Your hold ended before the receipt arrived. Book again.
errors.NOT_AWAITING_PAYMENT: This booking isn't waiting for a payment any more. Reload the page.
errors.RECEIPT_ALREADY_USED: This receipt was already used. Check the reference number.
errors.RECEIPT_TOO_LARGE: The file is too large. Send a smaller photo.
errors.AMOUNT_MISMATCH: The amount is less than the term price.
errors.network: No connection. Nothing was sent; try again.
errors.generic: We couldn't send the receipt. Try again.

card.lead: Show this to the driver or supervisor when you get on the bus.
card.lockedTitle: Your card opens after you subscribe
card.lockedBody: Book a seat and pay. Once finance approves your receipt, your card appears here.
card.expired: This code has expired. Connect to the internet to get a new one.
card.tip: The code changes every 30 seconds, so a screenshot won't work. Turn your screen brightness up when you scan.
